text.tspan: Weekly Report
To:Tom Ulaszek
From:Marty Pennock
Subject:Status Report
Date:June 11, 1992
Accomplishments
1.Continued mark-up of Sparrow Service Guide Chapter 2.
2.Completed PAL description for Sparrow Service Guide Chapter 2.
3.Finished sparrow overall block diagram for service guide.
4.Added power supply specification to sparrow service guide chapter 1.
5.Logged on to MANMAN for Sparrow BOM's.
6.Completed changes to Sparrow Service Guide Chapter 2 through IDE I/O Section.
7.Started conversion of Sparrow Service Guide Chapter 2 to ASCII text. It will be easier to
finish text edits in this mode.
8.Printed final rough draft of chapter 1 of Sparrow Service Guide.
9.Converted text file of Sparrow Chapter 1 to PageStream v2.2.
10.Edited print style for Sparrow Service Guide.
11.Created GEM file of Sparrow Expansion PCB for Bill Rehbock in Sunnyvale.
12.Got STBook Document data tree from Scott Barrows. Will generate a request to pull
documents needed for a Service Guide.
13.Got together with Gary Shimko to gather information for Service Guides for 2600 and
14.Requested ECO info from Robert Joplin, Jerry Smith to create ATB's for TT030 and
MEGA ST
15.Printed MEGA ST
Addendum for review. Got on MANMAN to pull new BOMs and ECO
History.
16.Got in touch with contract programmer to get diagnostics for Sparrow Service Guide
Chapter 3.
